categories.main_business_segments: Yonyou Auto Information Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive software and intelligent services sector, focusing on digital solutions for automotive marketing and aftermarket services. Its main products include automotive enterprise marketing systems, vehicle owner service platforms, automotive industry ecological service platforms, system operation and maintenance services, and intelligent device sales. The company serves automotive, engineering machinery, and motorcycle industries with software development, cloud services, and intelligent solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud-native technology, microservices architecture, DevOps, containerization, big data, and artificial intelligence, including AI visual recognition and deep neural networks. It has developed proprietary platforms such as the Yonyou Automotive Cloud-Native Technology Platform and the Yonyou Automotive Intelligent Development Platform. These platforms support multi-language configurations, AI edge device management, and intelligent data analytics to enhance automotive marketing and service operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include over 100 domestic and international automotive manufacturers and approximately 17,000 dealers. The company serves traditional and new energy vehicle manufacturers, commercial vehicle enterprises, engineering machinery, and motorcycle sectors. Major clients include leading Chinese automotive brands and new energy vehicle companies such as Seres, GAC, Changan, and Geely. The company also targets overseas markets, especially in Southeast Asia and Mexico.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with expanding business in overseas markets including Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, and Mexico. It plans to establish a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong to leverage regional advantages for better serving international clients and enhancing global competitiveness. Domestic operations are headquartered in Shanghai.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yonyou Auto operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive industry supply chain, providing software and digital solutions that enable automotive manufacturers and dealers to manage marketing, sales, after-sales services, and supply chain coordination. It also integrates third-party ecosystem services, positioning itself as a technology and service enabler within the automotive digital transformation ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in AI, cloud-native technologies, and intelligent data analytics to enhance automotive digital transformation. Strategic R&D projects focus on AI-powered visual recognition, intelligent device management, data-driven customer feedback analysis, and SaaS platforms for dealer operations. It prioritizes product internationalization, intelligent upgrades, ERP adaptation for automotive industry needs, and building data service platforms to maximize enterprise data value.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through software product sales, software development services, system operation and maintenance services, and intelligent device sales. The company employs a direct sales model with dedicated customer managers and also derives income from cloud services and ecosystem value-added services. It recognizes revenue based on contract fulfillment and service delivery progress.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yonyou Auto is a leading domestic provider of automotive marketing and aftermarket software and cloud services in China, recognized as a market leader with strong brand reputation and extensive client base. It faces competition from domestic software firms and potential entrants from large internet companies leveraging cloud, big data, and AI capabilities. The company maintains competitive advantages through deep industry expertise, continuous innovation, and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 594.8 million, a 19.16% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 80.7 million, down 29.7%. R&D investment increased to 16.08% of revenue. The company has a stable asset base with total assets around RMB 2.15 billion and equity of RMB 1.92 billion. Despite recent revenue decline due to market competition and client budget cuts, the company continues to invest in innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yonyou Auto differentiates itself by integrating deep automotive industry knowledge with advanced cloud-native and AI technologies to deliver intelligent, scalable, and customizable digital solutions. Its products enable efficient collaboration between manufacturers, dealers, and service providers, enhancing operational efficiency and customer experience. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive ecosystem partnerships, and focus on intelligent data analytics provide unique value in supporting automotive digital transformation and global expansion.
